The "team note" doesn't match the required assertion. Splitting into contiguous chunks would return `[['a','b','c'], ...]`, but the assertion expects `[['a','d','g','j','m'], ['b','e','h','k','n'], ['c','f','i','l']]`. That output is every nth element at each offset, so I'm keeping the stride-based solution.

```python
def list_split(lst, n):
    return [lst[i::n] for i in range(n)]
```
